scene: Your synth remix powers up three transit portals at the village edge.
picture: Flat side view. Along a wooden sky-station edge, the maglev dragon train rests far left. A pink bullet train idles centre. The young Chinese woman in her red jacket and skates stands right of centre holding synth headphones, facing the moored solar-sail junk on the far right under glowing village lanterns.
shown: the gleaming maglev dragon train waiting open-doored on the elevated track far left
the sleek pink bullet train idling with doors open at the centre platform
the golden solar-sail junk moored at the wooden sky-dock on the far right
